why: This is a named, study-adapted self-report measurement instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: 26-item five-subscale self-confidence questionnaire adapted from Scholz et al.
product_description: A Brazilian Portuguese 26-item Likert self-report assessment developed by the study authors to measure obstetric-procedure self-confidence among medical clerkship students across comprehension and preparation, procedural knowledge, motivation, expectation, and interest.
